Questions about embedding Formats, setup, prefilling and tracking. Ask a question Which embed formats are there? Four. Inline puts the booker in your page. A floating pop-up button sits in a corner of every page. Pop up via element click opens the booker from any button or link. Email embed puts a few of your open times into an email. How do I embed Cal.com on my site? Open a booking link in Cal.com, press Embed and choose a format. Set the theme, brand colour and layout, press Copy code, and paste the snippet into your site's HTML or React app. Can I prefill the booking form? Yes. Add the fields to the link as query parameters, such as name and email, or any custom question you've set up. The form opens with them filled in. Can I track which campaign a booking came from? Yes. Add UTM parameters to the link and they're kept with the booking, so you can tell which campaign, source or medium it came from. Can I build my own booker? On your Cal.com account, yes, with API v2. If booking is part of your own product, with your own users as the hosts, use coss.com Scheduling, from the team behind Cal.com. Does embed work with self-hosted Cal.com? Yes. The snippet points at your own instance, and every format works the same way. Ask anything else Put booking on your site Pick a format, copy the snippet, and paste it in.
